transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi there, I'm Dora. I'm a clinical conversational agent and I'm here to help answer any questions you might have about your cataract surgery recovery. Do you have any questions for me?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should avoid any exercise for 1 week after surgery, but after that, you can go back to light exercise, such as gardening. However, you should avoid strenuous exercise for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using any eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it's safe to continue using them, unless you've been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to the new lenses. However, if you have significant pain when it's bright, or severe light sensitivity, especially if your eye is also red and painful, we may need to assess this further. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, we'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you go outside. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for the vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation. But this should improve quickly and settle down over time. If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! So, just to confirm, all your questions have been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thanks again!

verdict.label: pass
